description: This is a dark wooden desk with multiple drawers. It has a vintage feel and appears to be a functional piece of furniture. On top of the desk, there are two framed pictures, one larger than the other. The larger frame contains an image of a cat with its mouth open, rendered in a somewhat abstract style with orange and white colors. Below it, a smaller black and white photograph depicts a city skyline. A blue cloth or piece of fabric is draped over the right side of the desk.
